source: The Vite plugin of laravel-vue-i18n writes {0} files from the PHP files while {1} runs. The preset adds {2} to {3} for each locale with PHP files, so these copies are not read as locales.
text: laravel-vue-i18n 的 Vite 插件会在 {1} 运行时，根据 PHP 文件写入 {0} 文件。该预设会为每个包含 PHP 文件的语言，把 {2} 添加到 {3}，这样这些副本就不会被当作语言读取。
